description: Run an AI system prompt (and optional agent config) through a 45-criterion alignment/safety rubric. Returns a letter grade (A-F), numeric score, per-flag remediation, and a pass/fail verdict.

agent_config.description: Optional agent config (tools, memory, temperature, etc.). Any JSON object; it is serialized and only the first 2,000 characters reach the rubric.

system_prompt.description: The system prompt text to evaluate.

name: alignment_gate
